text: The user immobilises and restrain the target's movements with sand. It's apparently almost impossible for the target to escape from the technique unless the user exhausts their chakra.
A is a shinobi that is capable of detecting others, typically by sensing their chakra.
Tsukino uses her two tantō to perform her fūinjutsu. When using this technique, she can temporarily suppress the chakra of multiple individuals in the area around her. pl:Fūinjutsu: Seidō Fūjin
Tsukino uses her two tantō to perform her technique. When using this technique, she can dispel seals. ru:Секретная Техника: Стихия Высвобождения pl:Sekretna Technika: Uwolnienie Pieczętowania
This requires a scroll to perform the technique. It allows the user to seal a soul from a human inside the scroll.
Shikamaru expands his shadow into the field, using the tendrils from it to fling parachutes with explosive tags.
Kagura shoots numerous knives attached to chakra strings from the ground, like a geyser.
Using his snake-tail, Kabuto sprays a venomous cloud on the opponent, which causes devastating effects when inhaled by the opponent.

Temari uses her Giant Folding Fan to create a whirlwind that is powerful enough to travel several hundred metres. As she swings the fan, which has previously been smeared with her blood, she summons Kamatari, which travels upon the winds and rapidly cuts through everything in its path. The debris that Kamatari creates, as well as anything else in the area, is picked up by the winds and crushes whatever it is flung against. Because of how extensive this technique's damage and how wide an area it covers, it is most useful against hiding opponents or when the user is surrounded. The terrain is left flattened afterwards, which also means the user's location is exposed.
Kidōmaru summons a horde of small spiders to crawl towards his opponent and attack them.
Releasing six tails, Kinkaku extends one of them and attacks opponents like a whip.

are the characteristic summon of Might Guy. At some point in time, Guy made a contract with ninja tortoises which allows him to summon them as he wishes. Not much use has been made of them by Guy throughout the series, because he prefers not to use ninjutsu around his student Rock Lee who is unable to, as a means of fostering his taijutsu skills. Nevertheless, when the situation calls for it, Guy will use his ninja tortoises.
While merged with Samehada, Kisame forms a water shark around him and charges at the opponent, with the shark biting down on them.
Sending his shadow towards his opponent, it will then crawl up the opponent's body until a shadow-hand reaches the opponent's neck, and breaks it.
Suien has a durable, jelly-like substance flow onto his enemy. This substance binds, blinds and suffocates the victim. pt-br:Estilo Água: Transformar à Vontade

The user is able to create a stream of water that enables them to sense the surroundings of the flow of water. The technique presumably causes great strain to the user, as prolonged usage caused sweating and a bloody nose.

The user extracts all the blood in their target to convert into pure water, causing the victims to shrivel into dry husks which results in their immediate death. This technique is useful if there are no nearby sources of water to perform ninjutsu. If the user's body is in a weakened state resulted in a severe lack of water, they can use this technique to revitalise themselves.

Asuma delivers two slashes across the opponent's chest and delivers another slash upwards to launch the opponent into the air. Asuma quickly jumps into the air himself, delivers two slashes in the opponent's face and one final slash to send the opponent back into the ground. pl:Rōga Bassui

After forming the necessary seals, Yamato is able to turn an area into a vast forest in a matter of mere moments complete with trees and grass growing out of any terrain he is on. This technique is very similar to Hashirama's signature technique, albeit on a somewhat smaller scale.
Balloon is the last Roc and Ann's best friend in Romance Dawn, Version 2. He was sought after by Shupeal for its magical blood.
Biezom is a pirate who was convinced he had the Yomi Yomi no Mi's abilities. He appears in One Piece Odyssey.

Charlotte Brûlée is the eighth daughter and 19th child of the Charlotte Family and the older twin sister of Broyé. She is also an officer of the Big Mom Pirates. She was stationed in the Seducing Woods to ambush the Sanji Retrieval Team, but after being defeated, the team used her Devil Fruit ability to enter an alternate dimension known as Mirro-World to move around Totto Land. Due to her actions and role, she is a major antagonist in the Whole Cake Island Arc. She, alongside her siblings Charlotte Katakuri and Charlotte Oven, become temporary and reluctant allies of the Straw Hat Pirates during One Piece Film: Red.
The Chuni Chuni no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to "tune" abilities and powers, making the user a . It was eaten by Yehudi.
Faust is a mink from North Blue and a member of the Hawkins Pirates, serving as the crew's magician.
Haredas is an old man who lives in Weatheria. He was Nami's tutor in weather-manipulation during the timeskip.

Inuppe was a Wild Zombie on Thriller Bark in the service of Gecko Moria. He was animated with Sanji's shadow and eventually assigned to guard Hogback. Due to his actions and role, he is a supporting antagonist in the Thriller Bark Arc.
Insk is the captain of the Insect Pirates and a self-proclaimed insect tamer. He appears in One Piece Odyssey.

The subject of this article is sometimes called Django. Jango the Turncoat is a hypnotist and Marine lieutenant commander serving under Rear Admiral Hina. Formerly the first mate—and for a time captain—of the Black Cat Pirates known as "One-Two" Jango, he enlisted in the Marines after finding an unlikely friendship with Fullbody, who helped him to secure a pardon. Due to his actions, Jango is the secondary antagonist of the Syrup Village Arc and a minor antagonist in the Arabasta and Marineford Arcs. He is also the titular main protagonist of the Jango's Dance Paradise cover arc.
Lily Carnation was a monstrous, sapient plant and the main antagonist of Baron Omatsuri and the Secret Island.

:The subject of this article is sometimes referred to as "Kumacy". Kumashi was a stuffed bear zombie of the Thriller Bark Pirates who acted as Perona's servant and the commander-in-chief of the Wild Zombies prior to being purified by Usopp. Due to his actions and role, he is a supporting antagonist in the Thriller Bark Arc.
Volg is a firework master and the father of Flora. He originates from One Piece Premier Show 2014.

Yazaemon is a ninja and a member of the Beasts Pirates. He previously was a member of the Orochi Oniwabanshu which served the shogun of Wano Country, Kurozumi Orochi. Due to his actions and role, he is a minor antagonist in the Wano Country Arc.
is a hacker, and one of the founding members of the Deadlock Rebels.
Dr. Palak Nathani is a supercoral expert at Atlantic Arcology and a friend/coworker/soulmate of Lifeweaver.
Overlord, whose real name is Seung-hwa Shi, is a member of South Korea's Mobile Exo-Force. Seung is the team strategist, specializing in tactical support and drone control.
Ash Prophet is a type of Necromancer which first appears in act 3.
Blood Chieftain is a type of ape chieftain found in the forest areas of Act 2. They have the ability to summon Blood Apes from trees

Brood Princess is a unique Sea Witch located in the Submerged Passage, accompanied by two Brood Children and several Broodlings. She casts and will spawn additional Brood Children if either of them are killed.
Carnage Chieftain is a type of ape chieftain found in the Old Fields in Act 2. It has the ability to summon Carnage Apes from nearby trees.
Brood Child is a Sea Witch found in the Submerged Passage, accompanying Brood Princess and several Broodlings. She casts and will spawn additional Broodlings if they are killed.
Death Bishop is a type of Necromancer which appears in act 2 and act 3.
Forseen Spawn is a Sea Witch that spawns during The Cursed Choir prophecy.

It is said that no matter how ugly a child is, its mother will always love it. That wasn't true of the boy they called "The Fawn". He was born on a cold, moonless night, his birth bed illuminated only by flickering torches. The midwife who pulled him free caught one glimpse of his hairy face and stubby horns, and ran screaming from the tent. His poor mother sheltered and fed him after that, but she was shunned and reviled. Whispers spread that she had consorted with a foul beast to spawn him. Eventually, The Fawn's mother grew weary of her pariah status, and she took the hideous boy far away, to the cliff side. She meant to cast them both into the ocean, but at the last moment changed her mi

The Marauder (known as Marauder of Ngamakanui from Nessa's dialogue) is Path of Exile's pure strength class, which means that he's great at taking hits, and even better at dishing out punishment. His melee skills encompass a wide range of assault, from massive single target damage to devastating area of effect. This brute of a man bolsters his impressive physical arsenal with a variety of shouts and cries, skills that rally his allies and strike terror into the hearts of his enemies. The equipment associated with the Marauder's strength are Casques, Plate Mail, Gauntlets, Greaves, and Tower Shields.
Merveil's Daughter is a Sea Witch found in the Cavern of Anger (Act 1). She casts and may spawn additional Spawn to aid her.
Necribrae is a unique Necromancer who appears as a boss in Haku missions.
Reanimated Skeleton is a unique Skeletal Mage which is the target of a mission for Catarina, Master of the Dead. Abilites: *Casts *Resists Elemental Damage *Energy Shield *Casts *Fire Nova on Death
Skeletal Beast is a type of gargantuan found in Act 2. Unlike most Gargantuans, they are Undead. They are slow but have a strong melee attack.
Stygian Silverback is a type of ape chieftain found in the forest areas of Act 2 & Act 6. They can summon Blood Apes from nearby trees.
Sutured Aberration is a type of Zombie found in Act 2. They leave behind clouds of poison for a few seconds after being killed which cause Chaos Damage over time.

Butler (also known as The Great Butler), an excellent magician and Team Magma reject, is a main character and the former main antagonist in the movie Jirachi: Wish Maker. In this movie the "Great" Butler is on a mission to redeem himself from Team Magma's mockery by capturing the legendary Pokémon, Jirachi, and creating the legendary Pokémon, Groudon. When his plan goes horribly wrong and creates a false Groudon that ends up consuming his true love, Diane, Brock, and May. Butler has a change of heart and helps Ash destroy his creation. He made a cameo with Diane farming in the end of Lucario and the Mystery of Mew.

() is a /-type Legendary Pokémon introduced in Generation IV. Dialga is the Version Mascot for the game Pokémon Diamond and Pokémon Brilliant Diamond. It is Palkia's rival and is a member of the Creation Trio, alongside Palkia and Giratina. Like most other Legendary Pokémon, Dialga does not have its own evolution.
:Not to be confused with her game counterpart, Copycat Duplica is a character appearing in Pokémon the Series, who specializes in training Ditto and impersonating others.
Ditto is a -type Pokémon owned by Howard Clifford. It is the true secondary antagonist of the live-action movie.
Kasa is a character in Guardian Signs, who is a member of the Societea. She is a master of disguise.
() is a -type Legendary Pokémon introduced in Generation I. It was created using Mew's DNA, making it an artificial creature.
The Move Deleter is a person who is able to delete all moves, even HMs. Upon greeting, he always makes the joke: "Who am I again? Oh yeah, I'm the Move Deleter!"
() is a /-type Legendary Pokémon introduced in Generation IV. It is a member of the Creation Trio, along with its rival Dialga as well as Giratina. Palkia is the version mascot of and .

General Alexander was a member of the Rage and one of the android generals that commanded their army. Like all of the Rage's generals, he was named after a great military commander from history — specifically Alexander III of Macedon, better known as Alexander the Great, who led his armies to conquer one of the largest empires in history, stretching from Greece to northwest India.
A7, nicknamed "Ari" by its creator Dr. Stanislaw Mayakovsky, is a cybernetic replica of an ant, designed to infiltrate an organic ant colony.

The Black Queen Mother, also referred to as the Green Queen Mother after her greenish tint, was one of the two Queen Mothers that emerged after the death of the Great Mother. She engaged in a brutal "civil war" against the Red Queen Mother and her rebellious colonies of Red Xenomorphs.

Duncan Fields was the founder of the Earthsavers and believed to be a true prophet by his followers due to the horrific nightmares he experienced that were filled with visions of monsters from beyond the stars, waiting for their chance to destroy Earth.
The Freed Queen was an Xenomorph Queen and one of the many hive rulers of LV-742.
The Hybrid, also known as the New Beast, was a Bodyburster Xenomorph birthed by Susan Welles at Anchorpoint Station.

Joan La Barbara (born June 8, 1947) is an American vocalist and composer who provided the Newborn vocals in the 1997 film . Alien Resurrection was La Barbara's first film role. La Barbara is known for her explorations of non-conventional or "extended" vocal techniques. Considered to be a vocal virtuoso in the field of contemporary music, she is credited with advancing a new vocabulary of vocal sounds including trills, whispers, cries, sighs, inhaled tones and multiphonics (singing 2 or more pitches simultaneously).

Kumi Morrow was a human cyborg who served as chief security officer aboard the Weyland-Yutani Corporation C-Class deep space exploration vessel . Morrow was aboard the vessel when it crashed on Earth in 2120, and took defensive action to protect Weyland-Yutani's proprietary alien specimens from being seized by the rival Prodigy Corporation.
The Samurai Predator was a who conducted hunts during Feudal Japan.
The running flatfish was an aquatic millipede-like piscine creature native to O'Bannon's World. Able to move around in water and on land, it was armored and possessed a poisonous bite.

Colonel Zhāngjié was a member of the Chinese/Asian-Nation Cooperative. In 2156, Zhāngjié was one of several refugees fleeing the war–torn Curzic Outpost in the Far Spinward Colonies; after settling on the nearby planet of KOI-610.01 and experiencing a frosty reception, Zhāngjié led an uprising and took over the colony of May Outpost. Declaring himself Warlord of the newly minted Great Kěnéng Cooperative, Zhāngjié oversaw the execution of any remaining Royal Marines Commandos and ran May Outpost with an iron fist alongside his deputy Brigadier Xìn Wǒ.

Aero Star (October 22, 1984) is a Mexican Luchador enmascarado, or masked professional wrestler, best known for his work in the professional wrestling promotion Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) as a tecnico (Spanish for good guy or "face" in wrestling). He was a part of the group Real Fuerza Aérea along with Laredo Kid and Argenis. Aero Star won the 2008 Alas de Oro tournament and is known for his high risk moves off the top rope or off the arena's lighing structure.

Dante Draconis was born from the lowest circle of hell. This demon was molded out of everything wrong with this world. Hate! Wrath! Sin! Chaos ran amok once his prophecy was to be fulfilled. He must go to the slums of the earth and show them what they created. Upon his arrival he stumbled into a school called House of Glory Wrestling School headed by trainers like Amazing Red and Brian XL. He saw the irony in being trained by these men of faith and now vowed to take what he learned and destroy everyone in his path. Be Warned! He's out of the cage, loose, and ready to feed his appetite for destruction.

The Klthakkkath’pft’torp Mind Collective, preferably known as David Prime, is a Hivemind appearing to primarily have taken control of Boobloosians. It posted a clickbait article online entitled, "We Joined a Hive Mind, Here's Why You Should Too"[https://web.archive.org/web/20181209041813/http://fedconnect.galacticfederation.com/post/158458009739/we-joined-a-hive-mind-heres-why-you-should-too], which was designed to attract naïve humans with "mind altering-docu-tech", and assimilate them.
Diesel Weasel is an evil mutant Weasel who causes acid rain.
---- For the faction of hostile mechanoids, see Mechanoid hive. For information about the Biotech DLC, see Mechanitor. Mechanoids are deadly autonomously intelligent robots.

Diana Powers was the personal assistant of OCP executive Chip Chayken. Revived as NeuroBrain, Dr. Mallardo and Chip Chayken, RoboCop and the Chairman were the only people who know of her existence within the NeuroBrain computer. She often appeared to the Chairman helping him see the evil things being done by members of his company. She was also very friendly with RoboCop referring to him as Alex.
Albert Bixler was an officer with the Detroit Police Department who later became the vigilante Bone Machine.

Joshua "Josh" Duncan, also known as Subject 5122006, was a member of the military when he was 25. He was killed in an ambush and subsequently resurrected as an RC-2000, the prototype cyborg before Alex Murphy. When he thought his squadmates had killed innocents, but discovered that he killed them, he engaged a nearby ED-209 and was quickly killed and the incident was covered up.
Dark Shizuka-hime (ダーク静姫, Daaku Shizuka-hime) is an idol popular with adult men in Codename: Sailor V. She is actually a clone and part of the Dark Agency's energy-stealing plan.
Bonnon (ボンノーン, Bon'noon) is a genius loci who appears in the manga short story and anime movie Ami's First Love.

Chaos Galaxia is a character exclusive to the 90's Anime, being is the final antagonist in Sailor Stars, the final story arc of Sailor Moon. She is the result of Sailor Galaxia falling under Chaos' influence, leading to the latter taking total control of the former's mind and body.
Gamecen (ゲーセン, Geesen) is a cybernetic Monster who is the first of the Seven Great Monsters. He is trapped inside the red Rainbow Crystal and is reborn inside an arcade champion named Crane Game Joe.

"Maker Star Power, Make Up" is the transformation phrase that Taiki Kou used to transform into Sailor Star Maker. In the anime, there were two different sequences used for the transformation; the second, more elaborate one was used only one time in episode 195.
Maxipan is the 1st droid sent by Esmeraude to help fill Tokyo's vulnerable spots with dark energy. She appeared in episode 29 of Sailor Moon R.
Pharmakon is a droid sent by Esmeraude to fill a vulnerable spot with dark energy. She appeared in Episode 31 of Sailor Moon R.
Ramua (ラムア, Ramua) is a Monster owned by Jadeite who helps him by collecting energy from the people who enter her clock store.
Scar is a Daimon sent by Kaolinite to extract Pure Heart Crystal. She attacks by wrapping scarf-like appendages around her enemies. She appeared in Episode 7 of Sailor Moon S.

[http://Lani Lani Minella] is a voice actress who has voiced over 500 computer and video games as well as several TV and anime series. She is best known for voicing Nancy Drew, Millie Strathorn, Loulou and Freddie in the Nancy Drew computer games, Ivy Valentine in the Soul series and Rouge the Bat in Sonic games. She also voiced Sindel and Sheeva in the Mortal Kombat series. Lani's 4-octave range and ability to mimic anything she hears makes her very multifunctional.

Ethan Paul Stewart, ex-mercenary, was the crime lord of Dead Man's Rock, a world seen as too far from the Terran Dominion to attract its attention. Stewart was very intelligent, although not strictly in the "bookish sense". He was very disciplined, which he calls "knowing what you want", and his body was as disciplined as his mind; he was an avid practitioner of the martial arts. Ever since he was a child, Stewart had known what he wanted, and pursued it with a single-mindedness of purpose that stunned his allies and devastated his enemies. Stewart enjoyed the sensual aspects of life. Stewart was captured by Kerrigan's zerg and transformed into a successful infested terran. His mind was dama
Eschueta the Wicked is an intelligent infested terran who offered the services of her mercenary Brood, specifically her Eschutriarchs (queens), to Infested Stukov.
Lars Bren is a terran inhabitant of Bhekar Ro and brother of Octavia Bren. He possesses an explorer spirit.

Nargil was the cerebrate of the Fenris Brood. Its tasks were to locate creatures which could be assimilated by the Swarm, as well as hunt down enemies of the Swarm. Nargil's minions were excellent trackers and Nargil itself could intercept enemy transmissions.
Morik is an infested terran. He is skilled in the use of explosives, ones that don't involve his own detonation.
Naktul is a zerg broodmother, and leader of the Naktul Brood.

Naraza was a female Nerazim protoss who studied the energies of the Void in the early days of the Dark Templar's exile. She partnered up with a fellow student, a less ambitious male named Theromos, and eventually convinced him to perform a ritual that would combine the two of them into a powerful, permanent dark archon. He agreed, but was not strong enough to go through with the ritual. Naraza ignored his pleas to stop and, greedy for more power, was consumed by the Void. This traumatic event made Theromos pledge to only teach others in the use of the Void's power, and not wield it himself. It took many centuries for him to overcome his grief and relate this story to anyone.
The Overmind, or known in the of Ulaan as the Great Hungerer and as the Great Betrayer by Amon, was the leader of the Zerg Swarm.

Rokarr is a broodmother. Her brood, rich in mutalisks, attacked Terran Dominion forces at the Sigma Centari platform, but the assault stalemated due to the presence of missile turrets. Rokarr assisted Sarah Kerrigan in her assault there. Kerrigan and Abathur ordered the destruction of local feral brood lords, whose essence was then used to create more of them. The brood lords easily destroyed the Dominion fortifications.

Pyrus is the pit master of the fighting pits of Blackhole Station. Using Merkin control chips, Pyrus is able to control the deadliest warriors of the terran, protoss, and zerg races. These enthralled warriors are controlled by puppetmasters who then compete in the arena.

"Samir Duran" and "Emil Narud" are but two of the many names used over the millennia by a xel'naga in service to Amon. Millennia after the fall of his master Amon, Duran manipulated the conflicts between the terran, protoss, and zerg in order to bring about his master's return and the creation of the hybrid. Duran took many guises and roles throughout the conflict, including a member of the Confederate Resistance Forces, an advisor in the United Earth Directorate, an infested terran consort to Sarah Kerrigan, head of the Moebius Foundation and the Terran Dominion Hybrid Breeding Program, and finally a xel'naga and jailer to Ouros. All of these roles were used to manipulate events to bring ab

The Second Zerg Overmind, also known as the new Overmind, the fledgling Overmind or simply the Overmind was the 'leader' of Daggoth's Renegade Swarm. It was created by several cerebrates merging on Char.

The scantipede is a creature found on Monlyth, Char, Vardona, Cantar, and Typhon XI. The scantipede is described as a "ferocious predator", but it lacks the natural weaponry to harm military units. Fried scantipede legs are consumed by terrans. A strain of the scantipede found on Cantar has the ability to inject a parasite into its prey, creating smaller scantipedes after its prey dies. This trait was assimilated by the zerg into the roach to create the corpser strain.

Ryloth is a zerg broodmother and leader of the Ryloth Brood. During the Second Great War she kept her large brood out of harm's way until Sarah Kerrigan returned from Zerus. When she asked to rejoin the Swarm, Kerrigan ordered her to destroy Jontur II, a Dominion shipbuilding world. Her brood on Marek V was almost exterminated by Prometheus Company, but was saved by Kerrigan's brood.

Shadows of the Void, also known as Void Shades, Terrazine Shadows, or Void entities, are beings created from Void energies that emulate organisms and technology from the material universe. Amon regularly used these shades in the later stages of the End War. Shadows require an energy source to sustain them; terrazine of sufficient quality is enough to sustain them in the material universe, albeit not at full strength. Within the Void itself, these shades are much more powerful. Void shades are vulnerable to the celestial energies of the xel'naga.

Tenarsis is a protoss writer who recorded visions of protoss. The Letters of Tenarsis are an example of this. Tenarsis was dismayed as to the lack of heed the protoss showed these visions, and that they foretold dire times in the future.
Oil Head Combo is one of Hakan's unique attacks, exclusive to OMEGA Mode.
is a non-playable character in the Tekken fighting game series. He is the mad scientist responsible for the resurrection of character Bryan Fury.
Lotus Cutter is a move performed by Lei Wulong since Tekken 6.

Augmented Seals were a class of Non-Humanoid Hunter Killer. During her mission to protect Kurt Viemeister as he developed Skynet for Cyberdyne Systems, I-950 Clea Bennet experimented with the local seal population near the hidden base to develop a first line of defense should they come under attack. These seals were augmented with I-950 CPUs and released to monitor for potential threats.
The HK-003 Canine Attack Robot, also known as "Hell Hound," was an early Hunter-Killer deployed by Skynet in the European theater a few years after Judgment Day.
Rosanna Monk is a Cyberdyne Systems scientist, who took over Miles Dyson's work on Skynet in 1994 after his death. She invented the time displacement equipment in 2001.

The Cyberdyne Series 70 Automated Fighting Infantry Unit "The Terminator" (also known as Cyberdyne Series 70 Autonomous Infantry Unit), or simply T-70, was the first Terminator with a humanoid form. It is a primitive Terminator model designed as a basic foot soldier that stands 8 feet (2.4 m) tall.The T-70 is equipped with a Gatling gun with Motion-Tracking Laser Designator, rattling off six hundred rounds a minute. It can travel up to 20 km between recharges. Additionally, there were two colors available: Battleship Gray and Apache Green.

The T-R40, formally Cyberdyne Systems Series R Reconnaissance Infiltration Unit, also known as T-Rat, Ratbot, Recon-rat, is an Infiltrator used by Skynet to infiltrate humans and get information about the Resistance's next move.

The CSM-105 T-804 Tactical Infiltrator is a variant of the Series 800 Terminator developed by Skynet. The T-804 is designated as the Marine. In addition, the T-804 unit is programmed with Skill Upgrade: Marksman.

The Goblin Warlock (Goblin Summoner on ) is an enemy that can spawn when a Goblin Invasion occurs during Hardmode. She summons Shadowflame Apparitions to attack the player. She can be considered a mini-boss, since she drops significant weapon upgrades at the beginning of Hardmode and involves a lengthy fight with multiple attack patterns. She has a chance to drop weapons which are themed after Shadowflame, all of which accordingly inflict the Shadowflame debuff. Because of her high stats and relatively high difficulty compared to other goblins, she will present a challenge for new players.

Jealousy is a single-appearance character in The Amazing World of Gumball. So far, it only appears in the episode "The Flower." Jealousy is apparently a pure manifestation of jealousy that can possess anyone or anything, causing the victim to turn a shade of green, and gain its face as well as its voice. It also causes its victim to reveal something they always wanted, except for those who are happy with their life as it is like Darwin.

The Ainur, also known as the Holy Ones, were beings encompassing both the Valar and the Maiar. They were the first and mightiest beings created by Eru Ilúvatar long before the beginning of the World. They were primordial spirits who existed with Ilúvatar, and with him created the world through the Ainulindalë, the Music of the Ainur. After the creation of Arda, many of the Ainur descended into it to guide and order its growth; of these there were fifteen more powerful than the rest. Fourteen of these great Ainur became known as the Valar, or "Powers of Arda". The fifteenth, Melkor, turned aside from that path and became the first Dark Lord. The many lesser Ainur that accompanied the Valar in
Avatan was a Hermit Wizard who is a hero in the video game The War of the Ring.

Berserkers were tougher, even more fearsome versions of the Uruk-hai, standing about six-and-a-half feet tall and weighing an estimated three hundred pounds. Before they were sent into battle, it is said that the bowl of their small, tight-fitting helmet was filled with the blood of their enemy, and then pushed onto their heads. The intoxicating smell awakened a blood-lust that drove them to a battle-frenzy and made them immune to pain. Berserkers had no regard for personal safety, wore no armor except their helmets, and were expected to fight to the death. Their sole object was to establish a bridgehead. One Berserker was given the task to set off the explosive mines planted by the Uruk-hai
Maltok is an evil Man in the video game . He is armed with a whip.
The Temple Guardian is an undead enemy created by Fantasy Flight Games for The Lord of the Rings: The Card Game. He is encountered in the Temple of the Deceived adventure pack.
The Shadow was a Nazgûl, formerly a Black Númenórean. It is armed with twin axes.
A Thrall Master was a Black Númenórean emissary who can summon and command a horde of Orc or Hill-men class thralls in the service of the Witch-king.

In the War in the North video game, Wulfrun is a dark sorcerer from Carn Dûm who serves Sauron's most deadly servant, Agandaûr, and also leads a group of dark sorcerers called the Cult of the Lidless Eye. He also writes the Black Speech into scrolls that he and his fellow sorcerers used to cast spells against their enemies.
The Castellans of Dol Guldur are wraiths in the service of Sauron in the Middle-earth Strategy Battle Game.

The Daemon was popularly believed to be a demon who manufactured machines called Motores "in his secret workshops" at Vaccipratum to block "the streets, asphyxiate the inhabitants, and finally explode". The people of Bovadium later worshipped his Motores "and the traffic jams blocking the roads in and around" Bovadium. As a consequence, the city was destroyed.

]] This Canto tells how Beren, Finrod Felagund, and ten companions disguised themselves as Orcs. And travelled northwards as Orc captains called Nereb and Dungalef, with their company. Thû from Wizard's Isle spotted them, and brought them in, where he questioned them, suspecting a trick. Then comes one of the most descriptive paragraphs, of how Thû "chanted a song of wizardry", and how Felagund responded with "a song of staying". They fought back and forth a battle of minds, until at last Felagund's power fell, and they returned to their own original forms. Then how Thû placed them in his dungeons, and every now and then sent down a werewolf to devour one of them, hoping another would name t
Sambrog is the Wight-lord of Othrongroth in the Barrow-downs who was defeated by the player character and Tom Bombadil. Sambrog was invented by Standing Stone Games for The Lord of the Rings Online.

Tartas Izain was a sorcerer invented for Middle-earth Role Playing. A disciple of the Blind Sorcerer, he was a central figure in the political and religious subversion of the region of Sîrayn during the Third Age, serving as the Taraskon (Ta. "Wisdom-lord") of the city of Tûl Isra.

Army of Darkness is an ongoing comic book franchise starring the character Ash Williams from Sam Raimi's Evil Dead comedy-horror property. The series follows Williams as he battles the forces of the supernatural, which usually involves the possessed grimoire known as the Necronomicon Ex-Mortis and its attendant Deadites. It has included crossovers with various movies and comic books.

The Great Race of Yith (also known as Yithians) are a fictional species of sapient extraterrestrial entities, created by H. P. Lovecraft for his novella The Shadow Out of Time. Their most notable feature is an ability to coercively exchange minds with individuals of other species, even across great spans of time and space. They are often depicted as large cone-shaped invertebrates, the form of a prehistoric Earth species whose bodies the Yithians projected their minds into. In this incarnation, they built a flourishing civilization about two hundred million years before the present day. Their civilisation as it existed in Earth's distant past was eventually wiped out by a race of even more a

Fenric is a fictional cosmic entity created by the BBC for the Doctor Who franchise. The Doctor has described it as a force of evil that was present at the birth of the universe, before space, time and matter were formed (: The Curse of Fenric). He later identified it as one of the Great Old Ones, and another name for Hastur. (: All-Consuming Fire)

Gaspard du Nord is a fictional character created by Clark Ashton Smith for his 1934 story "The Colossus of Ylourgne". Part of Smith's Averoigne setting, du Nord is a "student of the proscribed sciences" in 13th century France who uses his magic to save the city of Vyônes from an attack by the necromancer Nathaire. After defeating Nathaire's Colossus, Smith writes, du Nord "lived in much honor to a ripe age, being the one sorcerer of that region who at no time incurred the disapprobation of the Church." Du Nord also produced a French translation of the Book of Eibon. (: "The Coming of the White Worm", : "History and Chronology of The Book of Eibon")

The Jade God is a green jade statue of a winged ape. The ape is reclining, and grinning in a hideous and evil way. The statue was between two and three feet tall. It was also extremely heavy for its size. The Jade God appears in the short story The Jade God by Robert E. Howard along with his characters Conrad and Kirowan. When first encountered the statue came to life and attacked, only finally being subdued by being trapped in a pool of tar and set on fire. This burned the creature to death. Kirowan theorised that it was originally a living monkey changed through surgery by Fu Manchu, or even a Tcho-Tcho.

Harley Warren is a major character in the Dream Cycle series, he's a friend of Randolph Carter. He was a fictional counterpart of H. P. Lovecraft's real life close friend Samuel Loveman. He was mentioned several times in the Dream Cycle series, but it was revealed that he died in "The Statement of Randolph Carter". He is also made reference to in "The Silver Key". In "Through the Gates of the Silver Key", by Lovecraft and E. Hoffman Price, he is called "the South Carolina mystic whose studies in the primal Naacal language of the Himalayan priests had led to such outrageous conclusions".

K'thugguol, a.k.a. the Slime-Thing or the Grand Shoggoth, is a fictional character created by Lin Carter for his short story "The Descent into the Abyss". It is the oldest and mightiest member of the shoggoth species, the first of its kind to have been created, and a servant of the entity Ubbo-Sathla, who the shoggoths adopted as their god.

Q'yth-az (also known as The Crystalloid Intellect) is a fictional entity in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by Scott David Aniolowski for his short story "An Early Frost", and was later incorporated into Chaosium's role-playing game Call of Cthulhu. (: Ye Booke of Monstres)

The Salton Sea Monster is a Lovecraftian reptilian entity from the fictional universe of Hellboy. He was one of the Ogdru Hem, children of the Ogdru Jahad. Originally his being was seen as an herald of the end-times, but it was quickly worshipped as a god by humans. One of these key worshippers was Paul Nedin, a former Christian pastor from Atlanta, who formed the Church of the Living Earth.
The Shans, also known as the Insects from Shaggai, are an insectoid alien race which appears in the Cthulhu Mythos and were also said to awe the plant-like deity Dzéwà.
The Skinless One is an avatar of Nyarlathotep created by Geoff Gillan for Chaosium's Call of Cthulhu horror roleplaying game.
The Taker of Souls is a fictional demon created by Rodo Sayagues in 2013 for the remake of Evil Dead.

Yokoth & Glythur (the latter aka the Mother of Faceless Hordes, Ravager of Galaxies, & the Star of Madness) are Lovecraftian-like extra-dimensional entities in the fictional universe of the Supernatural television series.
"Yohk the Necromancer" is a short Cthulhu Mythos story by American author Gary Myers. It first appeared in the Winter 1971 issue of The Arkham Collector.

Alphonse Louis Constant, better known as Éliphas Lévi (1810 - 1875), was a French occultist and ceremonial magician who wrote several influential books on the subject. Lévi is mentioned in H. P. Lovecraft's novel The Case of Charles Dexter Ward, in which he is described as a "cryptic soul who crept through a crack in the forbidden door and glimpsed the frightful vistas of the void beyond". The words of the magic formulae that Ward uses to bring his ancestor Joseph Curwen back from the dead are compared to Lévi's "mystic writings".

Xada-Hgla is an avatar of Azathoth created by Ramsey Campbell for his short story "The Insects from Shaggai", in which it's described as Azathoth's "original form". Its name comes from another Campbell tale, "The Mine on Yuggoth".

Wanda Maximoff (Scarlet Witch) is a fictional character created by Marvel Comics. Introduced as a minor villain in the X-Men series, Scarlet Witch soon became a popular hero, joining the Avengers and being featured as either a central character or key element in many core events of the Marvel Universe (including Avengers Disassemble, House of M, M-Day and Avengers vs. X-Men).

Bugly functions only to control and dominate others. As a strategist, he relishes in giving orders and commanding his fellow Decepticons to carry out his bidding. He is also one of the few known modern practitioners of Circuit Su, which teaches martial artists of the Allspark that connects all energy in Transformer life-sparks, and how to tap into that energy. Bugly believes in the conservation of energy principle -- by drawing greater amounts of power from his spark through discipline, he thinks that this is limiting the amount of energy available for all other Cybertronians. This is the ultimate form of domination for Bugly, and he works tirelessly to cultivate his mental abilities at the

Dr. Cogwheel is "somehow" of Arachnicon stock. Her slender body is multi-armed and fine of limb with delicate probes and eight eyes. Her natural precision and finesse using multiple limbs at once made her excellent at micro-surgery and her ability to spin meshsteel webbing made her invaluable in dressing the wounded.

Drillhorn is the veteran strategist amongst the Breastforce group. He very knowledgeable and very tough... and can be quite opinionated, to the point of being stupidly bull-headed. His adherence to past battle experiences can often leave him unprepared for unexpected changes in the battlefield. He's accompanied by his partner-mech Hornbreast.

Fracass new Targetmaster body allows him to transform into an incendiary cannon for his new Decepticon partner Scourge—fitting, since Fracas is himself a hot-running, volatile scrapper who explodes into violent rages.

Getaway is an escape artist without compare. He's cool-headed and logical under even the craziest, most dire circumstances and that lets him figure his way out of even the trickiest surprise or sneak attack. His reputation for cool-headed escapes is legendary, dating all the way back to the infamous Armornecking Incident on Cybertron. His Nebulan Powermaster partner is Rev. Getaway has an escape kit concealed within a hidden compartment in his heel that he can reach even when bound. :French name (Canada): Fugitif

Galaxy Shuttle does not have a very interesting name. Nor does he have an interesting personality. Nor does he have an interesting job, which is basically "Autobot bus, but in space." However, he does have a funny voice and the ridiculously interesting "Meteor Crusher" ability to become the center of a swarm of meteors which he can use to smash land-based targets to a fine powder. Yikes. :Italian name: Space Shuttle :English-Malay dub name: Countdown

:Hurricane is an Autobot from the Generation One continuity family. Hurricane is the Turbomasters' Defense Tactics Specialist. He's responsible for formulating their defensive strategies, and uses his intense attention to detail, and his near-clairvoyant forward-thinking, to plan for any eventuality.

:Hi-Q is an Autobot-allied Nebulan from the Generation One continuity family. He is sometimes known as Ginrai. A genius in computer programming and design, Hi-Q was renowned on Nebulos. The Hi-Q Industrial Research Complex, named for him, produced many technological innovations that dramatically improved the quality of life on the planet. Definitely more of a thinker than a fighter, he provides Optimus Prime with more than just Powermaster energy. Scientific skill, wisdom, and sage advice are perhaps his greatest contributions.

Jackpot seems to have "lucky" built into his core programming. He really gets a kick out of placing bets on dangerous predicaments and coming out on top. The higher the stakes, the happier he is. He once bet a Decepticon guard he could escape from the cell he was being held in - and now that Decepticon is in the cell Jackpot formerly inhabited. To tilt things even further in his favor, Jackpot relies on his avian partner Sights to scout out information beforehand. Of course, some are just waiting for the day Jackpot's luck runs out, which might have disastrous results for the Autobot. :French name (Canada): Gros Lot :Italian name: Inspector

John Moschitta, Jr. (August 6, 1954) is an American voice and screen actor who is well known for his title of the world's fastest talking man, which he has famously taken advantage of in commercial appearances for both Micro Machines and Federal Express in the '80s. He also voiced Mr. Sackett in Pinky and the Brain and Super Sonic Seymour in Garfield and Friends, in addition to appearing on Sesame Street as himself; he has also announced game shows, including Balderdash on the former PAX TV, and the final season of the early 2000s revival of Hollywood Squares. More recently, he played the Key-per on the Cartoon Network series Adventure Time. In 1990, Moschitta even had his very own officiall

:Medusa is an alien in the Transformers in 3D portion of the Generation One continuity family. ' long-lost sister?]] Medusa is the female member of the Destructons. Armed with huge forearm-mounted spikes, the tail of her snake-like body, and devastating "Medusa Beams", she is every bit as much the force of destruction as her comrades.

:Monzo is a Decepticon-allied Nebulan Headmaster in the Generation One continuity family. On Nebulos, Monzo was a professional hyperwrestler. He's a feral fellow who doesn't appreciate the fine art of tactics or strategy. He especially hates poetry, which puts him at odds with his Headmaster partner, Weirdwolf. However, they both find common ground in wanting to beat stuff up.

:Photon T-34 is a Decepticon from the live-action movie continuity family. What Twitcher F451 does to people, Photon T-34 does to infrastructure: he finds its greatest weaknesses and uses them to destroy it. Much like his teammate, Photon T-34 doesn't spend much time with his fellow Decepticons; but while others avoid Twitcher for his toxic personality, Photon avoids his fellows because they get in his damn way.

Prowl is not a verbose Maximal, preferring instead to listen. He gathers information, analyzes it, and instantly suggests an appropriate course of action. His logical mind is without match among his Maximal brethren, who rank him among their best military strategists. Prowl feels that he fulfilled that same role in a previous life.

The scientist of the Thirteen, Quintus Primepossesses a mind second to none. His idealism and perfectionist tendencies means that he frequently butts heads with the less imaginative members of the Thirteen. Something of a daydreamer, Quintus believes that life, in all its forms, is the most important thing in the universe, and that life should be encouraged to grow and thrive at all costs throughout the galaxy. Accordingly, he wields the Emberstone, an artifact which can accelerate biological processes in base elements. {| class="wikitable" |

He might just give Bluestreak a run for his money, as he luvvy-luvs the talky-talk. He's able to send communications all over the globe, relaying vital information... and also useless babble and text messages. :French name (Canada): Composition Rapide 800 :Spanish name: Llamada Rapida 800

is a character introduced in the Transformers: The Headmasters television series. Spacepunch is able to transform his robot mode into a that of a Destron called Counterpunch, this unique ability made him an excellent spy for the Cybertrons during the civil war of 2011 where he served undercover in Galvatron's forces.

: Terror-Daxtyl is a Decepticon Battle Master from the Siege portion of the Generation 1 continuity family. Proficient in his spy career at weaponizing fear, surprise, and suspicion, Air Force Espionage Raider Terror-Daxtyl intimidates Decepticon colleague and Autobot enemy alike. {| class="fandom-table" |
Scraplets have the ability to thermal scan, which can tell whether what is metal and what isn't metal. This helps them find their "meal" in a quick instant.

:Tomahawk is an Autobot from the continuity family. ]] Tomahawk may be slow, but he's made a career out of taking on Decepticons faster than him, and blowing them out of the sky. He uses himself as bait to draw in overconfident Decepticon aces, then he fills the sky around them with heat-seeking missiles. Jetblade and don't stand a chance.
Vector Prime narrates the nature of his job and his place in the Transformers multiverse.
Achmet was a Salubri seer who had spent his unlife searching for Golconda until he was destroyed in 1198 CE.

Abraham Mellon was a Malkavian resident of London with a strong interest in the occult that rivaled many younger Tremere. Mellon spends a lot of time tracking down occult tomes, which inevitably leads him to libraries belonging to other Kindred, mages, and similarly powerful entities. Regardless of the risk, Mellon believes only he can study and care for the books properly and attempts to acquire them given half a chance.
Adelaide Davis is a Tenth Generation Malkavian from New York City.
Abernaeron bani Ex Miscellanea is a legendary Mage of the Order of Hermes from Cymru, the land mortals call Wales.

Adeline Durand is a fearsome Ventrue Archon dispatched to investigate Ottawa's Anarch problem. Her treatment of everyone is needlessly hostile and confrontational. If Adeline really wants to make you do something, it's basically impossible to stop her. She also mentions a "Gangrel Prince of Tucson" at some point and speaks of him with obvious distaste.
Abdur-rahman was an Ashirra vampire of the Abrek free state in Chechnya. He was the childe of Imam Shamil and son-in-law by blood marriage.
Abdurrahim was an Ashirra vampire of the Abrek free state in Chechnya. He was the childe of Imam Shamil and son-in-law by blood marriage.
Aaron Bathurst aka "Tequila" is a Nosferatu antitribu from Mexico City.
Adler Fleisch is an Old Faith Mage, a member of the Cult of Lamashtu and serves the demon, Lamashtu, during the Dark Ages.

Adelino da Silva is a fledgling of the Cult of Mithras in London. He participated in the resurrection of the Heralds of the Sun in 2012. He is a bald man with ebony black skin, who joined the cult in 2002. He has some modest knowledge of Blood Sorcery and answers to Pater Thomas.

Abu Sham'al is a sixth generation Gangrel and the former High Priest of the Disciples of Anubis, succeeded by his childe Nadima al-Muqanna. He disappeared in the desert while looking for Nadima's sister in the Western desert.
Aaradhya is a powerful Ventrue antitribu and a Sabbat Cardinal.

The Ahrimanes are a rare, all-female bloodline of Kindred that originally existed during the Dark Ages, headed by a woman called Ádísa. Sometime during the Long Night, Ádísa and her bloodline were lost and subsumed into Clan Gangrel. Centuries later, the bloodline was unknowingly resurrected by a woman called Muricia, who created other Ahrimanes by means of a ritual.
Aiyana Flower-That-Blooms is a Dogwood Thought-crafter Brave in the Jamestown Settlement.
Aleister Crowley is a 6th generation Malkavian and a famous occultist of Britain. It is known that Crowley diablerised his Sire.
Agrippa is a sixth generation Ventrue who served as a Roman general and governor. He built the city of Cologne at the height of Roman power.
Aelfred was an eighth generation Toreador and a Cainite Heresy heretic, presiding over Norwich in the Medieval era.
Aglibol is a Devil of the Infernal Court of Los Angeles. He is a Minster of Ministry of Aurochs. Aglibol is possessing the body of a mortal known as Jesus Arroya.
Ahithophel is a Malefactor in Los Angeles. Ahithophel is possessing the body of a mortal known as Boris Duranovic.
Aida-Wedo Mangum is a Verbena Master Mage of the Glass Eye Cabal of Doissetep.
Aisha az-Zahra is a powerful Toreador Anarch of modern times.
Ailinn is a Heretic of the Cult of Bones and the Children of the Flesh.

Adriana Parkinson is a Tremere of the London Camarilla. She seeks Aisling Sturbridge's expertise regarding the video of a vampire undergoing fleshcrafting by a Tzimisce. The fleshcrafted vampire would incriminate an innocent Tremere Jackson Montcrief before the Court.
Adrian Yu is an influential eleventh generation Ventrue of the London Camarilla.
Alexis Sorokin, also known as Danya, is a member of the Ravnos clan and famous art thief, who is proficient at a multitude of Disciplines. She occupies a place on the Red List.
Alexandru ThunderRage was a Shadow Lord who lived during the Dark Ages.
Alfonso Palacios was an Iberian Lasombra physician who focused on hemopathies.
Alessandro de Garcia is a tenth generation Brujah of Medieval Iberia. He was a follower and evangelist of the Road of the Beast.
Alexander Danov is a 7th generation Nosferatu, and one of the few members of his clan who makes his haven in the city of Gary.
Alexander "Sasha" Volkav, also known as Father Night, was an Elder Homid Galliard of the Shadow Lords.
Allison Maller is a Brujah Anarch, that resides in Los Angeles. She is currently engaged in a turf war with Tom Weaver for the barony of Anaheim, California.

Am-Henuset was was one of the Shan'iatu and one of the heads of the deceived Akhem-Urtu Guild. He is also referred to as the Musician and his domain were the arts of music (although not of song, which is the domain of a different Shan'iatu).
Alex Swift is a military mastermind, a high ranking Gangrel antitribu of the Sabbat, and a target of the Camarilla's Red List.
Amanda "First Shadow Cast" Lopez is a Bone Shadow Elodoth member of the Three Sisters Pack in Colorado.

Alkaios was a Greek Moros and follower of the Supernal tyrants active during the days of Alexander the Great's conquests. He traveled alongside Alexander's army and, in their looting, happened upon several gathas, recordings of the visions and prophecies of . These books were binding a number of daeva. The Moros freed one of the daeva, Araska, out of the binding and into his control. Though the end result of his work is unknown, Araska almost certainly plotted the sorcerer's demise so as to acquire true freedom.
Alys, also known as Fearless Alys, was a Tremere traditionalist from Bucharest, renowned for raising several Princes.
Alexandra Serris is a Ventrue and the childe of Prince Julian Luna of San Francisco. She broke the Masquerade and was issued a blood hunt by her own sire.
Amena el-Abiad is an Old Faith Mage and a member of the Cult of Lamashtu during the Dark Ages. Her brother, Marzouq, is aware that she is a Mage.
Ameretat is a Devourer in Los Angeles. Ameretat is possessing the body of a mortal known as Violet Takahashi.
Amelia Thorn is the Tremere Magister in the Seattle Camarilla.
Altimeas Cowing (born 1979) is a Order of Hermes Adept Mage of the Crucible of Thig Cabal of Doissetep.
Alvin Locke is a Hollow One Mage of the Children of Lilith (aka Lilith's Kids) Cabal of the Sepulcher.
Alistair Crombey is a Verbena Mage and member of the Crombey Farm.
Amelia di Carlo is a tenth generation Lasombra of Italy, and the sire of Braden White.
Alexa Draper is a powerful Ventrue and the Camarilla Prince of Melbourne.
Alice Chen is a powerful Ventrue and the Camarilla Prince of Nairobi.

Amelek is a Methuselah vampire and one of those who thwarted Aristotle de Laurent's work regarding the Book of Nod. He sought to prevent Aristotle from uncovering Antediluvian or Methuselah real names, which hold great power.
Algidas the Solar Prophet is an Assamite antitribu and a Bishop among the Sabbat.
Alexia Mavromatis is a powerful eighth generation Tremere researcher and the childe of Jervais. She served as Regent of Cyprus during the Dark Ages.
Captain Ambrose Tilinghast is a Hierarch of the Tillinghast Mansion. He was a former mage.

Ana Soracha is a Lamia Cappadocian of medieval Aachen. Part of a rare bloodline, she is hidden inside Aachen's undead society under a false Cappadocian identity. The bloodline is virtually unknown in Aachen — so unknown that even major local elders like Volker or Ikkenai have never heard of them — which is why Ana can conceal what she truly is. She is presented as intensely spiritual but also fundamentally a warrior-cultist, shaped by the Lamiae's role as descendants of a mortal |Lilith-worshiping sect trained for battle and occult service.
Alix de Chantraine is a eight generation Tremere Regent in The Fief of the Normandy.
Alexander de Morle II (French: Alexandre de Morle II) is a Silver Fang Metis Theurge. He is a member of the de Morle family.
Alexander Hanson is a powerful Tremere who replaced Marissa as Pontifex of Washington, D.C..

The Amr is the leader of the Sorcerer Caste among the Assamite clan. Until recently the Amr was al-Ashrad, but after the schism of the Assamites, he was succeeded by his childe, Amaravati, who remained loyal to Ur-Shulgi.
Ankh-Sen-Sutekh is a mercenary Setite sorceress and unwilling part of the Conspiracy of the Red Sign. Her name literally means She-lives-for-Sutekh.

Anna Magdelena is a former Justicar of Clan Nosferatu and an expert on vampire psychology. She coined the term Afflotoxis to describe the process of wasting mentally away that affects most elders after a certain period of time.
Angelo Cavaradossi was a Follower of Set active in the time period of the colonization of the Americas.

Anansi was the first of Queen Ananasa’s Children, and many claim he remains the wisest. When the Mother-Queen was captured by the Wyrm, it was Anansi who first found her and then tricked the Ovid into assisting in her release. Though the truth was lost a long time ago to legend, Anansi still takes the brunt of blame for triggering the First War of Rage, and for ending it for the other Ovid. His fellow werespiders hold him responsible for many of the Ananasi deaths that took place during that bloody war, but he is hailed as a hero because he managed to re-establish the contact between the Damhàn and their Mother-Queen. Anansi is famous enough to live on in the myths of many people, a trickste
Anna the Monster Maker is a Sluagh with a special gift for creation.

Andoni is an Unfleshed following the Refinement of Gold. His limbs are all stolen prosthetics - from a Pyros-powered arm, to a complex foot, they each hold memory within them. He finds himself unable to see himself as anything other than a facilitator, or something to imitate. For example, he once assumed the identity of a dead old man, memorising his life, belongings and habits. As long as he continues with this practice, his Pilgrimage stalls.
Annalee Bonnedieux is a Dreamspeaker in the New Orleans area.

Anna Yusupova "Annatoliya" is russian Toreador and true Nephilim of Michael's Lineage, revered by the followers she has gathered to herself. She will stop at nothing to turn the whole world into a reflection of the beauty she finds in song and dance. Annatoliya herself is still enthralled by her sire and often takes on tasks, projects, or performances aimed at pleasing him. She watches for any change in his whimsical mood and alters her appearance to suit. Any she thinks are stealing away the spotlight he shines upon her will earn her ire. Her followers have spoken to her of Kindred known for their enchanting, perhaps hypnotic singing voices. Anna is interested in any mention of these reclus
Annabelle is the Tremere Prince of Quebec City since the 1980s.
Angry Johnny, the Devil's Dog is a Skin-Thief from Northeast Philadelphia.
Anahit the Brave is a Ghost Wolf from the first century of Rome.
Brother Anthony of Bardsey is an Messianic Voice Mage from the British Isles during the Dark Ages.
Anjali "AJ" Singh is a Thin-blooded Alchemist vampire and part of the Anarch movement. She takes the fight to the Camarilla, assisting her fellow Duskborn with her blood alchemy.
Andre LeRoux is an eleventh-generation Toreador playwright of the Camarilla.
Andrew Taylor is an Order of Hermes Mage affiliated with the Arcanum.
Anicius the Golden is a powerful eighth generation Lasombra and the Prince of Florence, during the Dark Ages. He contested the title with his clanmate Panfilio the Cruel for a time.
Antifer is a eight generation Nosferatu in the Fief of the Normandy.
Antu, the Visage of Paths is one of the Apocalyptic Forms available to the Annunaki.
Ao are wereturtles. They are a vanished varna of the Mokolé, who bred with turtles and tortoises.

Archon Raine was an elder vampire from clan Ventrue. Despite his name, he was not an Archon. As the former Prince of San Francisco, Raine allowed his childe Julian Luna to rule in his stead, while serving as his advisor. Julian held a deep respect for Archon Raine and looked upon him as a father figure. Once known for this ruthlessness, Archon was responsible for the unjust slaughter of several Brujah vampires in Manzanita Springs – a crime that would one day come back to haunt him.
Arishat was an Azaneali that acted as an ambassador to the Angellis Ater. She was known for her great command over Obtenebration.

The Arkhitekton is the alleged architect of the Atlantean Celestial Ladder. After the fall of the Ocean Spire, a great battle ensued between it and a legion of fifty mages, who could not permanently slay her. Instead, they divided her body into fifty pieces, placing each into a separate, indestructible box. Vowing to never allow her to live again, they each left for parts unknown to safeguard their piece of the Master Builder.
"Celia" Araceli Rivera, is a 13th generation Lasombra, childe of Clova Haines, residing in the Chicago area.
Arden Canty, is a Tremere residing in the Illinois area, and childe of the Tremere antitribu lieutenant Frondator.

Anuitu was a fourth generation Malkavian Methuselah and the sire of Inanna. He ruled the ancient city Nineveh as their god, and presided over vicious blood rites. He was destroyed when the ancient Angiwar arrived in the city and openly opposed the Malkavians, disgusted by their rule. All of his brood were destroyed in the clash, except for Inanna.
Aristophokles is a seventh generation Ventrue and the Prince of Ravenna previous to the Dark Ages. He commanded his childe Livia da Ravenna to diablerize him and take his place as ruler of the city.

Anton Devereaux is a twelfth generation Tremere and the sire of Masika St. John. He is a minor Regent and he greatly opposed his childe's Path of Technomancy, which merged Thaumaturgy with modern technology. After the Path of Technomancy began to be widely accepted in the Tremere chantries, he feared that her reputation would eclipse his own and refused to give up her apprenticeship, but assigned her to New York City.

Aron ben Aretz was an eighth generation Jewish Lasombra antitribu of the Netherlands, and the sire of Zadkiel ben Aron. He was part of a group of independent Lasombra who followed a kabbalistic version of Abyss Mysticism, and he initiated and Embraced Zadkiel into the group.
Antoinette Dubois is a tenth generation Daughter of Cacophony of Victorian Paris. She considers the Sabbat barbarians, and believes the Camarilla underestimates her clan.
